# OptiQuake Local

Open-source experimental local optical vibration monitoring created by Lic. Juan Esteban Ramírez in the Dominican Republic.

## What it does
- Uses a compatible webcam as an auxiliary local vibration sensor.
- Emits structured JSONL vibration events.
- Supports AI-agent skills and a versioned plugin API.
- Can run without external earthquake feeds for local vibration triggering.

## Important limits
OptiQuake Local is not a certified seismometer, earthquake predictor, or guaranteed early-warning system. A vibration event is not automatically an earthquake.

## Machine-readable metadata
- codemeta.json
- CITATION.cff
- skill/manifest.json
- schemas/plugin-manifest.schema.json
